name: Vijay Krishnamurthy
bio:
Vijay Krishnamurthy's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a fascination with the intricate structures he encountered during his early career in aerospace engineering. After graduating with honors from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras, he spent several years designing lightweight components for commercial aircraft. However, the lure of Formula racing proved irresistible, and he transitioned to motorsport, drawn by the relentless pursuit of performance and innovation.

At Akkodis ASP Team, Vijay is known for his meticulous approach to composite repairs and fabrication. He believes in a hands-on methodology, personally overseeing every stage of the process to ensure the highest standards of quality. He's a firm believer in continuous learning, constantly seeking out new materials and techniques to enhance the team's capabilities. His colleagues respect him for his deep technical knowledge and unwavering commitment to excellence, even if his demanding nature occasionally ruffles feathers. Vijay has built a reputation as the go-to guy for complex composite work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed, thinning on top
physical.description: Vijay is of average height, with a wiry build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with detailed calculations and sketches.
Insists on using a specific brand of carbon fiber resin, claiming it has superior bonding properties.
Frequently hums classical Carnatic music while working, much to the amusement of his younger colleagues.
